## What changes for the marketer?

What task improves, for whom, and what changes before/after?

## Scope and evidence

Applicable division/product/market/audience, sources and proposed subject reviewer. Keep restricted evidence in its approved system; do not paste it here.

## Team usability

Entry point, required inputs/dependencies and expected result. Explain how another teammate can use this without the author's chat history. For a small correction, explain the defect fixed.

## Verification

Checks actually run and results; representative successful and missing-input cases when applicable. Distinguish walkthroughs from executed tests. List unavailable checks and untested live behavior.

For skill changes: `node scripts/sync-skills.mjs`. Repository check: `node scripts/validate.mjs`.

## Readiness

Draft or reviewed guidance, unresolved decisions, blockers and required reviewers. Repository review does not establish clinical/regulatory approval or authorize live operations.

- [ ] Assessed the applicable [contribution review criteria](https://github.com/the-digital-nicholas-olsen/marketing-ai/blob/main/.agents/skills/lumenis-contribution-review/SKILL.md); explained any that do not apply.
- [ ] Reviewed all changed files for secrets, private data, campaign records and restricted evidence.
- [ ] Used the canonical home and updated relevant discovery links and generated skills.

Contributor self-checks support reviewer inspection; they do not replace it.
